criterion: API user can read Batch
API user cannot read Maintenance Request, Issue or Asset
A Manufacturing User (no Stock or System Manager role) cannot create tracked units in bulk
evidence: API user roles ['MES Batch Reader', 'Manufacturing Manager', 'Manufacturing User', 'Stock User']; HTTP {'bulk_transfer_tracked_items': 403, 'bulk_create_tracked_items': 403, 'bulk_transfer_all_stock_items': 403}; Tracked Items 691 -> 691

criterion: One batch ID is created for 75 units with one stock receipt
Batch receipts do not create per-unit Tracked Items (item_tracking skips has_batch_no items)
A second create with the same batch ID is idempotent (no second receipt)
A new batch gets an 8-digit number from the sequence it shares with unit serials
A batch that ERPNext names itself on a receipt gets the next shared 8-digit number (item_tracking hook)
The desk scanner resolves a unit's 8-digit barcode to its tracked unit
Scanning the item code of a batch-tracked material is refused
evidence: RM-SIDE-HDL-B is tracked by batch: scan the batch label, not the item code
